deploy.startCommand: sh -c "echo '=== Running alembic upgrade heads ===' && alembic upgrade heads -v 2>&1 && echo '=== Checking tables ===' && python3 -c 'import asyncpg, os; import asyncio; async def check(): conn = await asyncpg.connect(os.environ["DATABASE_URL"]); rows = await conn.fetch("SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = \"promises\" ORDER BY ordinal_position"); await conn.close(); print("Columns:", [r[\"column_name\"] for r in rows])' 2>&1 && echo '=== Starting uvicorn ===' && uvicorn api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}"
